info.title: Guteneo — Developer API
info.description: REST contract for the beta candidate, documented on 21 September 2026. guteneo.com hosts the beta; the separate guteneo-preview.nclsppr.workers.dev demonstration rejects /api/* (PREVIEW_ONLY). This reference also describes the current candidate: read /api/capabilities for actual availability. Examples guarantee no tariff, provider sending or real assistant compatibility. Registered clients use OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code + PKCE S256, audience https://guteneo.com/mcp. No personal API key. First create a workspace in the browser, verify the email address and hold a verified account. During the Auth0 Free beta, MFA is optional; its status is evidence only when actually completed. Organization authority derives from authenticated membership and the bound connection, never the body or an arbitrary parameter. /api/dispatches/{id}/approve and /api/postal/preflights/{id}/transfer require a browser session and CSRF and are excluded from this OAuth API. /api/dispatches/{id}/protected-document (state), /password (password revelation) and /revoke (revocation) also require the sender's authenticated browser: Authorization headers are rejected and mutations require CSRF. An assistant, OAuth call or chat must never enter or read a password. Private administration and billing routes are also excluded. Confirmation is not delivery. Examples must not trigger real sending without explicit approval and activation. Roles belong to each workspace: admin, supervisor, member (operator), viewer (observer). The session exposes effective permissions. OAuth scope never replaces role authority. Supervisors may receive independent approval and reporting permissions. Member management remains restricted to the administrator's browser.

post.description: Sends nothing. Fax/postal require a ready documentId. Email requires recipient.email, subject and nonempty text (supplied or derived from HTML). Without documentId: no file. With ready documentId: attaches the original PDF by default. The same PDF with options.emailDeliveryMode=protected_link creates a password-protected link; options.protectedDays accepts 1, 7 or 30 (default 7). Before fingerprinting and review, the server adds the recipient link to final content, preserves the duration and quotes the EUR1 hosting surcharge per document where applicable. The server generates the password and reveals it only to the sender in their browser account; it must be shared separately with the recipient. Clients never supply protectedDocument, hostingId, link tokens or passwords. Multi-format recipient lists, Excel/other attachments and recipient accounts are planned, unavailable features. Fax uses recipient.phone; postal uses name, line1, postalCode, city and country with no nonempty line2. Requires a verified sender for the correct channel/mode (first available if senderId is absent). In production, every channel requires qualified private pricing and a valid quote: provider account, sender, options, source, tax, currency/FX and dates must match. Postal also requires an exact local provider draft and its price calculation; email includes billable data and qualified FX. Client-supplied provider amounts are rejected. A ceiling is not a tariff. Returns a raw Dispatch without approvalUrl: open https://guteneo.com/#/app/dispatch/{id} in the authenticated browser. A campaign must remain draft. For a new production letter, use /api/postal/preflights, open reviewUrl for consent, then /api/postal/preflights/{id}/quote; never fabricate preparedLetterId or review evidence. Fax v3 exposes a range excluding tax and a firm approved ceiling in faxPricing; confirmation reserves the ceiling and settlement awaits verified usage without requiring final cost before transmission.

get.description: Requires administrator authority or supervisor reporting permission as well as OAuth scope. Monthly history is tenant scoped: omitted period reads the current UTC month, latest selects the latest stored month at or before it, and availablePeriods lists all retained months plus the current month. A valid empty month returns no items and never creates quotas. Promotional welcome credit is always the current lifetime balance, separate from monthly channel limits. EUR50 is granted once per production organization created through the supported journey. Read returned amounts: credit does not activate transports. No renewal or top-up. Confirmation reserves the ceiling. Fixed quotes are consumed on provider acceptance; v3 faxes retain their reservation until verified usage reconciliation, even after delivery. For fractional quotes, the cent debit is ceil(accumulated nanoEUR / 10 000 000) minus ceil(previous accumulation / 10 000 000), at organization level; this is not a rounded per-email charge. Unknown outcomes retain reservations. Totals are integer EUR cents, never floats.

post.summary: Check PDF/UA or PDF/A with veraPDF
post.description: Purchase one automatic PDF/UA or PDF/A check for EUR0.10 excluding tax from available workspace credits. Requires a current authenticated browser administrator, CSRF and explicit purchase approval bound to exact document SHA-256, chosen profile, price, currency and version. Assistants and OAuth clients cannot start a new paid check or assert consent. The immutable operation atomically reserves the price; a completed usable report, including a report finding noncompliance, settles once. Technical failure, expired processing or withdrawn authority releases the hold without a charge. Replaying the same exact key returns the existing report without another debit or engine run. A new profile or PDF requires a new explicit purchase. Two concurrent checks are allowed; no recurring subscription or included monthly allowance exists. Automatic checks are not certification or legal assurance; human review remains necessary. Originals, quarantine, visibility and sending approvals remain unchanged.
